name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-cloud-status-mcp
title: Iran Cloud Status
description: Read-only status, incidents and prices of Iranian clouds: Arvan, Hamravesh, Chabokan, Liara, more.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_CLOUD_STATUS_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the status page requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
